title: Šúĺlance s Makom
hookLine: Slovakia-inspired šúĺlance s makom with 7 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Šúĺlance s Makom
steps.instructionTemplate: Prepare the Potatoes Boil the potatoes with their skins on until tender. Let them cool completely (preferably overnight), then peel and mash them finely. In a bowl, combine mashed potatoes, flour, semolina, and salt. Knead the mixture until you get a smooth, non-sticky dough. Incorporate {m53187_1}, {m53187_2}, {m53187_3}, and {m53187_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure potatoes first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Simmer & Dissolve Smoothly
steps.instructionTemplate: Shape the Šúĺlance Divide the dough into portions and roll each into a thin rope (about 1.5 cm in diameter). Cut into 3 cm-long pieces and roll between your palms to shape small dumplings. 4. Cook the Dumplings Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Incorporate {m53187_5}, {m53187_6}, and {m53187_7} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Melt & Whisk Smooth
steps.instructionTemplate: Drop in the dumplings in batches and cook until they float to the surface (about 2-3 minutes). Drain and transfer to a bowl. 5. Prepare the Topping In a separate bowl, mix ground poppy seeds and powdered sugar. Melt the butter and keep it ready.

steps.title: Cream Butter & Sugar Fluffy
steps.instructionTemplate: Assemble the Dish Drizzle the cooked dumplings with melted butter. Toss them in the poppy seed-sugar mixture until evenly coated. Serve warm, optionally with a dusting of extra powdered sugar or a drizzle of honey.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Measure aromatics and syrups before heating so timing stays crisp and your glaze hits glossy perfection.
